summary: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier and string-array mangling that hides a simple fs/https/execFileSync flow. On install, it fetches a Bun runtime ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the current platform, unpacks it, chmods the bun binary, and invokes that binary against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line Bun-CJS file (// @bun @bun-cjs banner) with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function WV8StW rotating a large numeric/string constant table) and mangled _0x-style identifiers. No hash or signature verification is performed on either the downloaded runtime or the payload. The package advertises a React chat UI and has no stated need for an alternate language runtime. Using a freshly downloaded alien runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled script at npm preinstall bypasses Node-based tooling and results in attacker-controlled code executing on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
